caption: The drawing depicts three views of an object resembling an acorn, rendered in shades of brown, tan, and muted green. In the upper left, the object appears whole, with a textured, cross-hatched cap in brown and a smooth, vertically-grooved body in lighter and darker shades of brown, with a small knob at the bottom. In the center, the object is shown in two parts: the cap is lifted above the base, displaying the cavity inside both pieces, with the same color and texture as the first view. To the right, the cap is illustrated from a top-down perspective, showing the concentric, woven-like texture and central point. The objects are set against a plain, lightly toned background that appears aged around the edges.
title: Snuff Box
